title: A GitHub plugin installation can finish without a runnable Python check
symptom: A user delegated GitHub BoxBox plugin installation to Codex on another computer, then saw read-only behavior and no apparent Python inspection or style application. Exact destination installation commands, effective sandbox and hook trust were not available.

rootCause.summary: Confirmed for the reproducible marketplace-only route on Codex 0.166.0: marketplace and plugin add succeed, but the thin plugin has no configured local engine, so an explicit Python check exits 2. Codex discovers three enabled but untrusted hooks; installing a plugin does not trust them. Previously, no-engine post/stop hooks exited 0 silently. Attribution to the originally reported computer remains unconfirmed; missing engine, untrusted hooks and host read-only permissions remain separate states.

requestedOutcome: A GitHub-assisted installation must continue through the included-engine installer and an actual first file check. Engine readiness, Python verification, automatic hook review and source write permission must remain distinguishable.
decisions: Keep the thin marketplace payload and existing included-engine installer; no runtime registry engine lookup or publication is introduced.
Probe the permanent engine and default approval data before host registration; check a disposable Python fixture when Python exists.
Missing or nonfunctional Python is reported as unavailable and does not block other languages; engine/config/approval faults, malformed reports and source mutations still refuse installation.
Preserve user hook trust and source files; no-engine hooks report NOT_RUN without blocking.
Keep Python coverage expansion and automatic source fixing outside this change.

actions.description: Reproduce real Codex GitHub marketplace installation and inspect native hook discovery/trust.
Add installed runtime/Python verification, explicit inactive hook context, and first-use setup instructions.
Verify fresh/repair readiness refusal before host registration, optional missing Python, native Codex feedback and explicit alignment.
Complete final full-candidate checks, real installer repair and independent Opus fix verification.
Inspect the originally reported macOS installation transcript, exact client and effective hook/permission state.

verification.name: Actual marketplace-only installation
verification.scope: Codex 0.166.0, GitHub main 5a09427, isolated macOS profile.
verification.result: Both install commands succeeded; installed Python check exited 2 without a report, and hooks/list reported three untrusted handlers.

verification.name: Installed candidate first-use and native hooks
verification.scope: Local archive identified by artifactSha256 in the evidence; current installer plus byte-identical native runtime core reused under impact scope.
verification.result: 35 helper tests and 11 artifact tests passed, including unavailable/version/parser-failing optional Python with a valid TypeScript Check, and corrupt engine refusal before registration with repair preservation. Native delivery used one-invocation audited-hook trust bypass. The separate no-tool default control completed with zero receipts. Two Stop FAIL receipts were followed by native completion; explicit Align/check/re-run passed. Read-only native control denied edits. Ordinary user-reviewed delivery remains unverified.

verification.name: Final candidate checks and audit
verification.scope: Frozen implementation after independent Sonnet review followups.
verification.result: Final bun run check exited 0: 727 tests, TypeScript and shell syntax passed. Opus fix-verification PASS condition was satisfied by this full result. Actual Codex installer refresh verified Python and unchanged native runtime hashes. Plugin guard passed; final changed-file lint is recorded in the evidence.

verification.name: Destination and other native platforms
verification.scope: Originally reported computer, native Windows, Linux/WSL and desktop UI.
verification.result: No original installation transcript or destination access was available. CLI macOS results do not establish these cells.

related.note: Probe before registration and report separate readiness states.
Installed first-use, optional Python, refusal and repair preservation.
Inactive hook JSON and source read-only contract.
Canonical first-use and hook trust instructions.
Bounded results, archive identity and explicit exclusions.

history.summary: Recorded the user symptom without assuming that read-only behavior proves engine absence.
A fresh real Codex GitHub installation reproduced no configured engine and three untrusted hooks; original-machine attribution remains unknown.
Added NOT_RUN visibility and permanent-runtime/Python verification before registration; preserved existing installer and human trust boundaries.
Excluded a model timeout and an invalid Delete+Add probe patch from native edit claims. The corrected exact Update File probe subsequently exercised the real hook flow.
Focused helper/artifact and macOS native positive/inactive cases passed; final suite/audit and original destination remain separate.

Opus audit rejected treating an installed but nonfunctional optional Python as fatal for every language. Revised the preflight policy, added parser/version failure and corruption/repair cases, and clarified that native delivery evidence uses one-invocation trust bypass rather than user approval.

Optional Python health/parser failures now remain unavailable without blocking other languages; corrupted engine still refuses and restores prior data. Final suite passed 727 tests with tsc/shell checks; Opus fix-verification condition was satisfied. Native delivery trust-bypass and read-only controls are explicitly scoped; original destination attribution remains open.
